approval_evidence.quote: Approval Date(s) and History, Letters, Labels, Reviews for NDA 021077 ... 08/24/2000 ORIG-1 Approval Type 4 - New Combination; ADVAIR DISKUS 100/50 FLUTICASONE PROPIONATE; SALMETEROL XINAFOATE POWDER;INHALATION

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2000Q1, the first quarter of the first year for which a GSK document prints Seretide/Advair worldwide sales by quarter in GBP millions: the 'Quarterly trend' schedules (pharmaceutical sales by quarter, total Group) of GSK's Annual Reports for 2000, 2001 and 2002 give 2000: 34, 47, 50, 77; 2001: 98, 194, 240, 318; 2002: 363, 416, 392 (and 460 for Q4, which the series already held). The quarterly results announcements of 2001 and 2002 are paper filings on EDGAR (the CIK 1131399 index lists them as 'AUTO-GENERATED PAPER DOCUMENT'), which is why the quarters are read from the Annual Reports on gsk.com. Before 2000 the product is annual only: the Annual Report 2000 prints Seretide 1999 sales of GBP 48 million for the year (launched in Europe in 1999 by Glaxo Wellcome) and no quarterly split, and Glaxo Wellcome's 1999 quarterly announcements are not electronically available.
notes: Seretide launched in Europe in 1999 and Advair in the US (FDA approval 2000-08-24); no cited GSK document states the launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null. UK GAAP applies to 2000Q1-2004Q4 as printed in those releases and IFRS from 2005Q1; the Seretide/Advair definition did not change. The 2000 quarters are Glaxo Wellcome's (the merger with SmithKline Beecham completed on 27 December 2000); GSK's Annual Report 2000 prints them as part of the combined Group, and Seretide was a Glaxo Wellcome product only. The 2000 report prints the product as 'Seretide'; 'Advair' is the US name used from the April 2001 US launch. The Q1 2002 results announcement (investegate mirror of the 24 April 2002 release) prints the same 363 for Q1 2002 as the Annual Report 2002 schedule.
search_log: fetched data.sec.gov submissions CIK0001131399 (recent + 3 history pages, 2001-2026): 6,124 6-K and 39 6-K/A filings; 20-F 25

2003-2011: fetched every 6-K filed in the 4 results windows each year and kept those whose text contains 'Seretide' and 'turnover' (40 documents matched, 4 of them excluded below; the 2001-2002 6-Ks are paper placeholders on EDGAR)

2012-2026: selected 6-Ks whose primaryDocDescription is 1ST/2ND/3RD QUARTER RESULTS, HALF YEARLY/HALF-YEAR REPORT or FINAL RESULTS; 2012-02-07 6-K (Q4 2011) added by hand because its description is generic ('FORM 6-K')
excluded as duplicates/restatements: 6-K 2004-10-29 and 2005-02-10 (IFRS restatements of 2003-2004), 6-K 2008-05-06 (second filing of the Q1 2008 release), 2008-02-07 text-only copy of Q4 2007

per release: product row taken from the 'Pharmaceuticals/Vaccines turnover' regional tables (Total column = worldwide); each quarter cross-checked: Q1+Q2 = printed six-month row, +Q3 = printed nine-month row, +Q4 = printed full-year row

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: Series is worldwide Seretide/Advair; first sale anywhere was in Europe before the U.S.; U.S. (measured): GSK 20-F filed 2003-03-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1131399/000102123103000405/b701404-20f.htm): 'Advair/Seretide launched in mid-April 2001 achieved sales of £328 million', i.e. U.S. 2001Q2.; Europe (measured, undated): GSK Annual Report 2001 (https://www.gsk.com/media/j1ghxkvx/annual-report-2001.pdf) says that in the UK and Germany Seretide 'had been available for over a year' in its 2000 discussion, so launch was before 2001 but no quarter is stated.; Glaxo Wellcome (CIK 9

Extension before 2002Q4: EDGAR index for CIK 1131399 (2001-2002) lists the quarterly 6-Ks as paper; fetched all text 6-Ks filed 2002-10-30 to 2003-02-11: none is a results announcement. Found the Annual Reports on gsk.com (annual-report-2000.pdf, annual-report-2001.pdf, annual-report-2002.pdf), each with a 'Quarterly trend' schedule 'Pharmaceutical sales - total Group'; read with pdfplumber and pdftotext -layout. Row sums check: 2000 34+47+50+77 = 208 (the report states Seretide GBP 208m), 2001 98+194+240+318 = 850 (states GBP 850m), 2002 363+416+392+460 = 1,631 (the 2003-02-12 6-K states 1,631).

1999 and earlier: Annual Report 2000 pharmaceutical sales table prints Seretide 1999 as 48 (annual, growth >100%), 1998 nil; Glaxo Wellcome plc (CIKs 0000944737 and 0000813633) has no 6-K or 20-F on EDGAR in this period; a web search for Glaxo Wellcome 1999 quarterly results found only a trade-press note of 17 February 2000 repeating the GBP 48m annual figure. No 1999 quarter is printed anywhere located.
